task_definition.task_description: I need alternatives to the black Sony WH-1000XM5 in electronics, then pick the best recommendation that can cover a quantity of 2. After that, place the order with my active coupon using my credit card, generate an invoice and payment link for user@example.com, and then create a summary document of the recommendations, selected item, order, and invoice and send me an app notification.

user_input.query: Please find me some alternatives in electronics to the black Sony WH-1000XM5 with product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, then choose the best recommendation that can cover quantity 2. After that, place the order for user_id user_001 using my active coupon_status active with the 20.0 discount and pay with my credit_card. The subtotal is 199.99 and the payment_amount is 250.0. Please use my preferred payment_gateway stripe, then generate an invoice and a payment link for user@example.com. Also create a summary document titled Trip Summary that includes the recommendations, the selected item, the order, and the invoice, tagged with finance and travel, and send me an app notification when it’s done.
user_input.title: Trip Summary
